title: SIR Notices to Digitised Voters
summary: The Special Revision of Electoral Rolls (SIR) in Telangana will serve notices to 21% of digitised voters. In Delhi, nearly 67% of enumeration forms have been digitised. The deadline for submitting SIR forms is today. Over 33% of forms are still not in digital records. The government is working to digitise voter records as part of the poll roll revision drive.
summary_points: SIR will serve notices to 21% of digitised voters in Telangana.
67% of enumeration forms have been digitised in Delhi.
The deadline for submitting SIR forms is today.
Over 33% of forms are still not in digital records.
The government is working to digitise voter records.
